_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::structural_dynamics#4 — M_DAMP and K_DAMP are read only when DAMPING is set to 'Rayleigh'; its default is 'None'. On one single-HEX8 GenAlpha deck, adding M_DAMP: 5.0 and K_DAMP: 0.05 with DAMPING left at its default still passes the undamped result test pinned to 1e-9 (COEFFS_ONLY_RESULT_FAILURES=0) and 4C never mentions damping at all (COEFFS_ONLY_WARNINGS=0) — the coefficients are simply inert. Adding DAMPING: 'Rayleigh' with the same two numbers moves the answer to 1.53054041008010792e-02. The one loud case is DAMPING: 'Rayleigh' without coefficients: 'Rayleigh damping parameter K_DAMP not explicitly given.' from adapter/4C_adapter_str_structure_new.cpp, exit 1. So 4C refuses to invent a coefficient but will silently ignore one you supplied. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Rayleigh damping parameter K_DAMP not explicitly given.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: give the COEFFS_ONLY arm the DAMPING switch it was missing. Its answer then moves off the undamped one, COEFFS_ONLY_RESULT_FAILURES stops being 0 and EXIT_COEFFS_ONLY becomes 1, so the fixture must go red.
remove the second pathology: give the last arm its coefficients. The missing-K_DAMP abort vanishes and EXIT_RAYLEIGH_NO_COEFFS becomes 1->0, so the fixture must go red.
